en.template: Help me decide whether to buy a first condo in {city}. We earn {income}, pay {rent} and have {savings}. Compare a resale and a new unit at {price}, with the bank lending 100% and 90%, rebuild the upfront budget and the buy-versus-rent table with my numbers, keep a six-month reserve outside the budget, and check any bank, developer or agent quote I paste in, marking anything unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Research the lending rules, fees and bank rates, then build the guide and check it
phases.note: Bank of Thailand loan rules, transfer fees, mortgage rates and the buy-versus-rent comparison
phases.judgment: It fixed its own answer mid-run: reading the Bank of Thailand rule directly showed a first-home loan can already cover 100% of the price, so it rebuilt the budget tables in all three files and re-ran its own cross-check, which recomputes the figures by a different method (206 of 206 passed). It also warned that it had read the 2020 text, not any later amendments, and told readers to confirm with the bank.
